svg.text: Indonesia sits at the bottom of the GP/kg ladder in every reaction it buys

Orange = Indonesian accounts (direct export + PT Thai Wah Indonesia intercompany) · grey = all other TDC customers with ≥ 5 t · bubble area = YTD Sep-26 tonnes · bands = HVA tier (red below floor, amber floor–target, green at/above target)
Product GP per kg = net sales − actual cost − F&I (same basis as the HVA GP tier tracker) · YTD Jan–Sep 2026 · source: TDC Profitability data_Actual

Read: a full reactor (PO-XL, XL) makes Indonesian volume a displacement of 6–7 THB/kg business, not a fixed-cost play; a spare reactor (PO, AC, Others) can take volume at a floor price but not below it.
Capacity per reaction from the Baseline sheet — confirm nameplate with the plant (XL shows above 100%). Floor / target per reaction = HVA GP tier tracker.
